observations: Photo 0 shows a set of 12 clear glass spice jars with wooden lids, arranged in a white foam tray. A cardboard box and a sheet of black label stickers with a white marker are also visible.

Photo 2 shows the same set from a different angle, with all 12 jars in the foam tray, next to a cardboard box. The jars have wooden lids and appear to be sealed with rubber gaskets.
